modeReason: Three stories clear relevance 12 (novelty×magnitude×breadth ≥8): the open web closing its doors to AI agents, a coding agent's breach exposing thousands of users' API keys, and Amazon's AI flagging union risk in UK warehouses — all well past the fresh threshold of 8.
phrase: AI agents promised to browse, book, and shop for you everywhere online. The web just started showing more of them the door.
phraseAlternatives: Autonomous agents were built to go anywhere online for you. This week, more of the internet told them to turn back.
AI agents can now shop, book, and browse on their own. More websites are deciding they would rather not host the shopper.
The pitch for AI agents was that they could do anything online for you. Online is increasingly saying no thanks.
Agents were supposed to open every door on the internet. Instead, more doors are closing on the agents.

brief.concept: An AI agent built to shop, book, and browse for people walks up to a row of website doors, and one more swings shut just as it arrives.
brief.metaphor: The open web as a street of doorways that are, one by one, deciding to lock out the agent.

cast.who: a small AI agent robot carrying a half-full shopping bag, with a blinking cursor-arrow badge
a row of plain doorways standing for different websites, each with a hanging OPEN/CLOSED sign
a human hand reaching out from the nearest doorway to flip its sign from OPEN to CLOSED

brief.composition: Wide, calm street scene. The robot agent enters from the left, mid-step, bag swinging. Three simple doorway shapes stand in a row to the right, each at a slightly different height. The nearest door's sign is caught mid-flip by a human hand poking out from inside; the other two doors already show CLOSED. Plenty of flat cream paper background, thick duotone outlines, no clutter beyond the three required elements.
brief.alt: A small robot carrying a shopping bag walks toward a row of doorways. A hand reaches out from the nearest doorway to flip its hanging sign from OPEN to CLOSED just as the robot arrives.
